item.title: Remembering Melba Jeane Morris
item.description: Melba Jeane Morris, age 101, was born in Minden, Louisiana, and spent her early childhood on a farm in Yellow Pine. She graduated from Fair Park High School and continued her education at Louisiana State Normal School (now Northwestern State University) in Natchitoches. She later earned a master’s degree from the University of the Philippines. … Continue reading Remembering Melba Jeane Morris

item.title: Cavs hang tough for a half, but Blinn takes charge
item.description: JOURNAL SPORTS The Bossier Parish Community College basketball team went toe-to-toe with traditional Region XIV stalwart Blinn College Monday night in Brenham, Texas, but couldn’t sustain the performance for all 40 minutes. item.description: By JACKSON MANSEL, AusOpen.com Christian Harrison and Neal Skupski have always yearned for hardcourt doubles supremacy. item.title: Most parish parks reopen following winter weather, South Bossier Park remains closed
item.description: The Bossier Parish Parks and Recreation Department announces that all Parish parks have reopened to the public following closures caused by the recent extreme winter weather. South Bossier Park is the only location that will remain closed until further notice.
